subject: [PATCH 3/3] mm/vmscan: consolidate promo vs. high watermark checks

reviews.author: SJ Park
reviews.summary: Identified a typo in the commit message and suggested correcting it. Otherwise, found the patch to be good and applied it with a Reviewed-by tag.
reviews.raw_body:

> zones up to, which is the promo watermark when NUMA balancing memory

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch consolidates the logic for determining the watermark that kswapd reclaims zones up to, simplifying the code and removing an unnecessary include file. The consolidation is achieved by introducing a new helper function, `kswapd_wmark_pages`, which returns the correct watermark based on the system's NUMA balancing mode.
